name: Exp_AdaptiveRenko_Duplex
summary: This Expert Advisor trades both long and short directions based on Adaptive Renko brick reversals. It detects Renko brick color changes as trend signals and opens positions accordingly, using an adaptive brick size that adjusts to market volatility for dynamic trend identification.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自适应Renko砖块反转信号进行双向交易。它检测Renko砖块颜色变化作为趋势信号并相应开仓，使用自适应砖块大小根据市场波动率动态调整以识别趋势。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于自适应Renko砖块图的趋势跟踪方法。入场条件为：当Renko砖块由跌转涨（颜色从红变绿）时做多，由涨转跌（颜色从绿变红）时做空，砖块大小根据ATR或其他波动率指标自适应调整以适应不同市场环境。出场条件通常包括反向砖块出现时平仓，或结合固定止损止盈。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数方式。资金管理方面，Duplex设计意味着EA同时支持多空双向交易，不会仅单向持仓。由于Renko本身过滤了市场噪音，策略在趋势明确时表现较好，但在震荡行情中可能产生频繁假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Adaptive Renko brick chart trend-following method. Entry conditions: go long when Renko bricks reverse from bearish to bullish (color changes from red to green), and go short when bricks reverse from bullish to bearish (color changes from green to red), with the brick size adaptively adjusting based on ATR or other volatility indicators to suit different market conditions. Exit conditions typically include closing positions when a reverse brick appears, or combining fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing may use fixed lots or account-balance-proportional lot sizing. The Duplex design means the EA supports both long and short directional trading simultaneously rather than being unidirectional. Since Renko inherently filters market noise, the strategy performs well during clear trends but may generate frequent false signals during ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

pros: 自适应砖块大小能根据市场波动率动态调整，在不同市况下保持较好适应性
Renko砖块图天然过滤市场噪音，减少虚假信号干扰
Duplex双向交易设计充分利用趋势跟踪策略的多空机会
pros_en: Adaptive brick size dynamically adjusts to market volatility, maintaining good adaptability across different market conditions
Renko brick charts inherently filter market noise, reducing false signal interference
Duplex bidirectional trading design fully capitalizes on both long and short opportunities in trend-following strategies
cons: Renko基于价格而非时间，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁反转信号导致过度交易
默认止损止盈为0存在较大风险敞口，缺乏有效的风险控制机制
自适应砖块大小在极端波动行情下可能调整不及时，导致信号滞后或过早入场
cons_en: Renko is price-based rather than time-based, prone to frequent reversal signals in ranging markets leading to overtrading
Default stop-loss and take-profit of 0 creates significant risk exposure with no effective risk control mechanism
Adaptive brick size may not adjust promptly during extreme volatility, causing signal lag or premature entries
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如更高周期MA或ADX），在震荡行情中减少虚假信号
完善止损止盈机制，建议加入ATR动态止损和追踪止损功能
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as higher timeframe MA or ADX) to reduce false signals during ranging markets
Improve stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms, recommend adding ATR-based dynamic stops and trailing stop functionality

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为0，缺乏风险控制，可能导致单笔大额亏损
Renko反转信号在震荡市中频繁触发，可能造成连续小幅亏损累积
缺少最大回撤限制和仓位控制机制
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit of 0 lacks risk control, potentially leading to large single-trade losses
Renko reversal signals trigger frequently in ranging markets, potentially accumulating consecutive small losses
Missing maximum drawdown limit and position sizing control mechanisms
